name: Realtek RTL8152 / RTL8153 USB Ethernet adapters
summary: The Realtek chips inside most cheap USB Ethernet adapters and many USB-C docks: RTL8152 (10/100) and RTL8153 (gigabit).

linux.notes: Driven by r8152, which is built into Linux. The new network connection shows up with a name like enx followed by the adapter's address.

darwin.notes: Recent macOS versions use RTL8153 adapters natively in their standard (CDC-ECM) mode. Realtek also published a macOS driver for older versions. Plug Doctor has not confirmed native support for every RTL8152 adapter.

win32.notes: Windows normally installs the driver by itself, through Windows Update if needed.
